008c2024.text: Over the course of six years, the cunning Arathi outmaneuvered and outfought the rival tribes. After every victory, the Arathi offered peace and equality to the conquered people; thus, they won the loyalty of those they had beaten. Eventually the Arathi tribe came to include many disparate tribes, and the ranks of its army grew vast.
008c2024.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

0577595f.text: The elves found that although humans were innately clumsy in their handling of magic, they possessed a startling natural affinity for it. One hundred men were taught the very basics of the elves' magical secrets: no more than was absolutely necessary to combat the trolls. Convinced that their human students were ready to aid in the struggle, the elves left Strom and traveled north alongside the mighty armies of King Thoradin.
0577595f.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

27b8a6e1.text: United under one banner, the human tribes developed a strong, optimistic culture. Thoradin, the king of Arathor, knew that the mysterious elves in the northlands were under constant siege by the trolls, but refused to risk the safety of his people in defense of reclusive strangers. Many months passed as rumors of the elves' supposed defeat trickled down from the north. It was only when weary ambassadors from Quel'Thalas reached Strom that Thoradin realized how great the troll threat truly was.
27b8a6e1.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

7051efe3.text: As the high elves fought for their lives against the trolls' fierce onslaught, the scattered, nomadic humans of Lordaeron fought to consolidate their own tribal lands. The tribes of early humanity raided each other's settlements with little heed for racial unification or honor.
7051efe3.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

9902ba56.text: Yet one tribe, known as the Arathi, saw that the trolls were becoming too great a threat to ignore. The Arathi wished to bring all of the tribes under its rule so that they could provide a unified front against the troll warbands.
9902ba56.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

b6eec3ea.text: As the troll armies broke and attempted to flee, Thoradin's armies ran them down and slaughtered every last one of their soldiers. The trolls would never fully recover from their defeat, and history would never see the trolls rise as one nation again. Assured that Quel'Thalas was saved from destruction, the elves made a pledge of loyalty and friendship to the nation of Arathor and to the bloodline of its king, Thoradin. Humans and elves would nurture peaceful relations for ages to come.
b6eec3ea.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

c38bfb41.text: Confident that they could hold their own against the troll warbands or even the reclusive elves if need be, the Arathi warlords decided to construct a mighty fortress city in the southern regions of Lordaeron. The city-state, named Strom, became the capital of the Arathi nation, Arathor. As Arathor prospered, humans from all over the vast continent traveled south to the protection and safety of Strom.
c38bfb41.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

c70ff27d.text: Thoradin, distrustful of any magic, agreed to aid the elves out of necessity. Almost immediately, elven sorcerers arrived in Arathor and began to instruct a group of humans in the ways of magic.
c70ff27d.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

d88f58b6.text: The elves informed Thoradin that the troll armies were vast and that once the trolls had destroyed Quel'Thalas, they would move on to attack the southlands. The desperate elves, in dire need of military aid, hastily agreed to teach certain select humans to wield magic in exchange for their help against the warbands.
d88f58b6.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

ddf1a602.text: The hundred human magi and a multitude of elven sorcerers called down the fury of the heavens and set the troll armies ablaze. The elemental fires prevented the trolls from regenerating their wounds and burned their tortured forms from the inside out.
ddf1a602.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

e4026d73.text: The united elf and human armies clashed against the overwhelming troll warbands at the foot of the Alterac Mountains. The battle lasted for many days, but the unflagging armies of Arathor never tired or gave an inch of ground before the troll onslaught. The elven lords deemed that the time had come to release the powers of their magic upon the enemy.
e4026d73.title: Arathor and the Troll Wars

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12920|d0c90775.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
12920|d0c90775.text: Greetings, $N. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2388|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

2399|536469cb.name: Daryl Stack
2399|536469cb.text: The place is a bit drafty... but what do I care? I'm dead.

248199|4ee395b7.name: Beneris
248199|4ee395b7.text: Oh! Greetings, friend. Feel free to browse my wares.

248201|5de3438e.name: Pawani
248201|5de3438e.text: Greetings, friend! I have an ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

250686|3c4152a4.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
250686|3c4152a4.text: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

255894|b859690b.name: Innkeeper Zizplink
255894|b859690b.text:
Ah, a worldly explorer!

Can you smell that fresh, ocean air? Just don't inhale too deeply. Sometimes it smells a bit fishy.

255895|428e3a94.name: Grizzek
255895|428e3a94.text: Hey, hey! What can I do for ya?

255993|91e62151.name: Grakna
255993|91e62151.text: As experienced as one might be, I urge you to travel with caution. These plains are home to ferocious beasts and others who seek to remove us from these lands. Even the skies have become too dangerous for our wyverns.

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256418|bb1dfbeb.name: Krom'rosh
256418|bb1dfbeb.text: The blood of our enemy across these plains has only led to the flourishing of these lands.

256655|0c543544.name: Gorg
256655|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

256658|dab68b20.name: Gur'dok
256658|dab68b20.text: Crafting a battle-ready blade is the key to victory. I won't rest until I've mastered my craft.

256675|472c8799.name: Innkeeper Toka
256675|472c8799.text: You must be tired from your travels. Take rest while you can.

260359|07a29a02.name: Sadi
260359|07a29a02.text: If you're lookin' to catch a ride to Steamwheedle over in Tanaris, you've come to the right place.

260405|4fabc167.name: Wharfmaster Steamfizzle
260405|4fabc167.text: Ain't no better way to get to the Eastern Kingdoms than my ships. This port goes straight to Powderfuse Port on the coast of the Riverglades. Pirate free nearly guaranteed!

260487|eebc7daf.name: Gritta Chumwater
260487|eebc7daf.text:
Hey hey hey! Watch where you're trackin' your shoes.

Tryin' to run a classy establishment here!

260558|c2467ddc.name: Krix
260558|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

260559|ba36c7cb.name: Gilliwigs
260559|ba36c7cb.text: Look at that view, would ya? Don't get much better than this.

260562|54362962.name: Melbin Powderfuse
260562|54362962.text:
This town was a vacant lot before I showed up. Everything you see here was built by me. It belongs to ME!

Question is, what can YOU do for me?

260566|722af728.name: Fizzix Boomshot
260566|722af728.text: Ain't nothing ever gonna compare to the smell of freshly discharged gunpowder, friend.

260568|94d7fc8d.name: Jazzle Cheapshot
260568|94d7fc8d.text:
No fights goin' on today, pal. The Horde and the Alliance are too busy killin' each other out in the fields when there's perfectly good coin to be made doin' that in my arena! Go figure.

Come back when I get this place up and runnin'.

260570|fef1739b.name: Stitch Pinwizzle
260570|fef1739b.text: Lookin' for some new threads? You came to the right place.

260857|9c546da9.name: Tazzik
260857|9c546da9.text: Nothin' like a good view of the port so you can call first dibs on shipments.

263570|8ac1454b.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|8ac1454b.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders. As you improve your standing with the Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a variety of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3040|3f898c12.name: Urek Thunderhorn
3040|3f898c12.text: Do you prefer guns or bows?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3328|0402cd55.name: Ormok
3328|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3341|bdd68929.name: Gann Stonespire
3341|bdd68929.text:
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.

What can I do for you, $N?

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3401|8830368a.name: Shenthul
3401|8830368a.text:
The Shattered Hand's influence dominates these lands. We are the veil which covers Kalimdor: The protectorates, the police, the judges, the jury, and ultimately, the executioners. We see all, we know all.

You have grown much in the time which you have spent in service of the Hand, $N. The time has come to send you into the field.

Are you prepared to undertake your next mission?

3402|6cb63392.name: Zando'zan
3402|6cb63392.text: Zando'zan of the Shattered Hand. How can Zando'zan help you? He can't! He won't!

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3539|8259246a.name: Ott
3539|8259246a.text:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4419|56a29b40.name: Race Master Kronkrider
4419|56a29b40.text: Who has the fastest car?  Who knows?!?

4429|3785ab5a.name: Goblin Pit Crewman
4429|3785ab5a.text: I heard they were going to try to blow up the gnome's car in the next race!  True or not, I'd stand clear of their pit area.

4429|89022ad5.name: Goblin Pit Crewman
4429|89022ad5.text: If I were you, I'd buy a goblin race voucher.  Rooting for the other team is a waste of time.

4429|dae00750.name: Goblin Pit Crewman
4429|dae00750.text: If it weren't for that cursed, gnomish luck, they'd never win a race!

4430|612c4cf5.name: Gnome Pit Crewman
4430|612c4cf5.text: If it weren't for the goblins' inconceivable, dumb luck, they'd crash their car during every race!

4430|7689341a.name: Gnome Pit Crewman
4430|7689341a.text: My Gizmotic Almanacotron says that we should beat the goblins by twenty seconds more than we did last time!

4430|da38516b.name: Gnome Pit Crewman
4430|da38516b.text: My son could design a faster car than that clunky goblin junk heap!

4453|f1c43d2c.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
4453|f1c43d2c.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4582|0deb5cc3.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6496|28f510c2.name: Brivelthwerp
6496|28f510c2.text: Can I interest you in some ice-cold ice cream?

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7161|4df495bf.name: Wrenix the Wretched
7161|4df495bf.text: Pirates. I hate them. I don't just hate them; I despise them with every fiber of my being. What with all the 'ARRRRR!' and 'YARRR!' and those awful birds they keep as pets - how could anyone stand pirates, let alone be a pirate?

7233|0c7ac5e1.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|0c7ac5e1.text:
Something plagues this tower. I've fallen ill and the other Venture Co. employees that work near or in the tower have also become sick.

Just last week, two of our patrollers died, only to instantly come back to life as mindless drones!

The lifeforce is draining from my body. I can feel myself losing control. Urges taking over... Bad urges... *Fizzule slaps himself in the face* Not yet... Listen... Mine is a position of power. This position privies me to some sensitive information.

7233|5dd10b4a.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|5dd10b4a.text:
The tower's defenses are at their weakest right now. The patrollers, sentries, lookouts, and even Gallywix himself are all infected and highly vulnerable to your special abilities and attacks.

I want to see you enter that tower and when you exit, I want to see you covered in the blood of your enemies, the head of Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix in your hands, and the last of that poison in your pack. Take what you recover to Shenthul. He'll know what to do... I hope.

7233|7c135186.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|7c135186.text:
Fast forward to the present: The resultant formula works, allowing for the creation of a more controlled drone, however, the drawback is that the inactive compound is extremely volatile.

Gallywix, everyone in this tower and everyone outside are infected with the poison. It's affecting our minds and our bodies. Our internal organs have become soft and extremely fragile. This is your chance, $N. I don't have the strength to carry on and I sense that soon I will become one of 'them.'

7233|96ccafbb.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|96ccafbb.text:
Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix finally intervened, taking the surplus of poisons to his tower, here at the Sludge Fen, in order to study and research the unstable nature of the toxins. A decision was finally reached to share the secret of the poison with the Defias Brotherhood in exchange for a very large supply of a stable, usable poison.

Klaven Mortwake of the Defias Brotherhood was tasked with the job of altering the chemical properties of Zanzil's mixture.

7233|db7d283e.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|db7d283e.text:
About five months ago, the Venture Co.'s Stranglethorn division got their hands on a special poison from a shady merchant in Booty Bay named Crank Fizzlebub. Fizzlebub had apparently stolen the poison from Zanzil!

Yes, Zanzil the Outcast - the troll that was exiled from his own tribe due to the nature of his 'experiments' in necromancy.

Naturally, once they had the poison, they proceeded to test it on each other. The results were disastrous.

7683|21424dde.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|21424dde.text: Yes, I see that. I can't say I'm pleased yet another one of my brilliant concoctions has been wasted.

7683|70f4a6e4.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|70f4a6e4.text:
<Alessandro lets out a frustrated sigh and pinches the bridge of his nose with boney fingers.>

Fine. Yes, give it here. At least I can reuse the glass vial.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

7714|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Byula
7714|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

7824|c5ceacbe.name: Bulkrek Ragefist
7824|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

8139|fe2e6e48.name: Jabbey
8139|fe2e6e48.text: What can I do for ya?

8579|0d76e20b.name: Yeh'kinya
8579|0d76e20b.text: Greetings, $c.  Though time and drink have dulled my outer senses, my inner eyes remain strong.

9501|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Adegwa
9501|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

881-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-progress.text: The great cat calls to you, $N.
881-progress.title: Echeyakee

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

98298-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-progress.text: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
98298-progress.title: Arugal's Folly
